root_cause: Not a fault. Jaya's arrival is real (geofence then BLE pre-arrival triggers, her phone reads Garage A), but pre-arrival clears as 'arrived' only when the HVAC zone itself (zone_2 rooms: Jaya Bedroom, Game Room, Media, Upstairs Hallway, etc.) becomes occupied. She first spends time in rooms of other zones (Kitchen, Powder, Patio, Breakfast Nook), so the zone stays empty until the pre-arrival window times out. Scope/design mismatch between 'person arrived home' and 'zone occupied'.
